title: Governor's Scholars Program
sponsor: Commonwealth of Kentucky, Governor's Scholars Program
who_text: Kentucky residents in 11th grade who plan to return to a Kentucky school, applying through their school
description: A free five-week summer program for Kentucky high school students, held on college campuses. You take classes, live in a dorm, and join activities with scholars from across the state. The state and private donors cover tuition, room and board; you bring transportation and pocket money, plus a refundable housing deposit. Your school sets its own deadline, earlier than the state date.
